_help: Manual fixes applied by scripts/build-ramen.mjs. Never written by the script.
Match by shop name or Japanese name (case-insensitive). Any of name, name_ja, style, address, address_ja, prefecture, district, lat, lng, description, hours, hours_note replace the CSV value.
"exclude": true drops the shop. Re-run: npm run data:ramen
"editionNotes" maps an edition to a note shown on the page (e.g. when only part of its results is public).

editionNotes.2026-2027: Partial list. The full 2026-2027 rankings are only in the printed book so far; this map has the publicly announced winners plus new-shop ranks transcribed by fans. More will be added when the results are published online.
